text.text: SOURCE / Expand OneLibrary and choose the attached test USB; local folders stay separate.
BROWSE / Select a track, then choose LOAD 1–4. Playing targets are locked.
PLAYLIST / Select a playlist in the native folder tree. No copying or conversion needed by this skin.
SEARCH / Type in the native search bar. KEYBOARD opens the VirtualDJ touch keyboard.
TAG LIST / VirtualDJ SIDELIST. This list is local to VirtualDJ, not a Pioneer USB Tag List.
